Name: DE-EstimatesQuotes
Statement:
select	est.Oid as EstimateId,
        est.Number + ' - ' + est.Name as Estimate,
        est.Number as EstimateNumber,
        dep.Id as DepartmentId,
        dep.Name as Department,
        est.ModifiedOnUtc as ModifiedOn,
        wfs.Oid as StageId,
        wfs.Name as Stage,
        cli.Id as ClientId,
        cli.Name as Client,
        cnt.Number + ' - ' + cnt.Name as Contract,
        cnt.Id as ContractId,
        prj.Id as ProjectId,
        prj.Number + ' - ' + prj.Name as Project,
        eit.Oid as EstimateItemId,
        eit.Name as EstimateItem,
        eit.Description as EstimateItemDescription,
        eid.Description as EstimateItemDetailDescription,
        sup.Oid as SupplierId,
        sup.Name as Supplier,
        art.Oid as ServiceId,
        art.Name as Service,
        eid.Type as EstimateItemDetailType,
        ddp.Id as EstimateItemDetailDepartmentId,
        ddp.Name as EstimateItemDetailDepartment,
        eid.UserTypologyGroup as EstimateItemDetailTypologyGroupId,
        utg.Name as EstimateItemDetailTypologyGroup,
        eid.[User] as EstimateItemDetailUserId,
        usr.Name as EstimateItemDetailUser,
        pro.Oid as ProductId,
        pro.Name as Product,
        brd.Oid as BrandId,
        brd.Name as Brand,
        eid.Oid as EstimateItemDetailId,
        est.Currency as CurrencyId,
        cur.Name as Currency,
        est.Exchange as Exchange,
        ari.Oid as EstimateItemServiceId,
        ari.Name as EstimateItemService,
        eit.Retainer as EstimateItemRetainer,
        eit.QuantityIncome as EstimateItemQuantityIncome,
        eit.ValueWithoutVatIncome as EstimateItemValueWithoutVatIncome,
        eit.VatValueIncome as EstimateItemVatValueIncome,
        eit.ValueWithVatIncome as EstimateItemValueWithVatIncome,
        eit.ClientDirectTotal as EstimateItemClientDirectTotal,
        eit.ValueWithVatIncomeWithClientDirect as EstimateItemValueWithVatIncomeWithClientDirect,
        eid.UnitPriceCost * eid.Hours as EstimateItemDetailCost,
        eid.UnitPriceIncome * eid.Hours as EstimateItemDetailIncome,
        eid.TableRate as EstimateItemDetailTableRate,
        eid.UnitPriceCost as EstimateItemDetailUnitPriceCost,
        eid.UnitPriceIncome * eid.Hours as EstimateItemDetailUnitPriceIncome,
        eid.DiscountCost,
        eid.QuantityCost,
        eid.ValueWithoutVatCost,
        eid.VatValueCost,
        eid.ValueWithVatCost,
        eid.DiscountIncome,
        eid.QuantityIncome,
        eid.AgencyCommissionValue,
        eid.ValueWithoutVatIncome,
        eid.Margin,
        eid.MarginPercentage
from 	Estimate est
            join EstimateItem eit on eit.Estimate = est.Oid
            join EstimateItemDetail eid on eit.Oid = eid.EstimateItem
            join JobType typ on typ.Oid = est.JobType
            join WorkflowState wfs on wfs.Oid = est.WorkflowState
            join WorkflowStateType wst on wst.Oid = wfs.WorkflowStateType
            join ClientLookup cli on cli.Id = est.Client
            left join ProjectLookup prj on prj.Id = est.Project
            left join ContractLookup cnt on cnt.Id = isnull(est.Contract, prj.Contract)
            left join CommercialClientProduct pro on pro.Oid = est.Product
            left join Brand brd on brd.Oid = pro.Brand
            left join UserTypologyGroup utg on utg.Oid = eid.UserTypologyGroup
            left join Currency cur on cur.Oid = est.Currency
            join DepartmentLookup dep on dep.Id = est.Department
            left join DepartmentLookup ddp on ddp.Id = eid.Department
            left join UserLookup usr on usr.Id = eid.[User]
            left join Supplier sup on sup.Oid = eid.SupplierCost
            left join Article art on art.Oid = eid.Article
            left join Article ari on ari.Oid = eit.Article
